text_block_list.text:
The dirt GⅠ exclusive to the Classic class 
held at Oi Racecourse, the Japan Dirt 
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, a night race is really something 
else, huh?

It's a night race. The only Classic-tier 
Dirt GⅠ, and being held in the dead of 
midsummer, the heat in the air is intense.

If you go in with a weak mindset, you'll 
be swallowed by the heat. Even so, 
regardless—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
We can't afford to lose, can we? After 
all, we've done so much practice.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'll complete every single part of the 
routine you prepared just for me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well then, for the finishing touch, I'll 
have you do the usual. With enough force 
to blow away the stars in the night sky!

Sincere emotions poured into every single 
stroke. A passionate exchange that could 
only exist between Wonder Acute and 
myself.

"I have no more doubts. Today, Wonder 
Acute and I will face this as one."

Fufu, today is graduation day, isn't it? 
Yes—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Supreme Overlord Graduation Ceremony! 
Show me your night performance. Show me 
the duet you've both learned to play.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If they remain the same mismatched duo as 
always, running well will be out of reach. 
However, if their hearts truly connect—
